author: homelab
name: New listening port
description: Port of Wazuh 100901 + 533 (Kibana only): host-snapshot cmd:listen change or osquery listening_ports added on a non-loopback/non-Docker address. Tuned 2026-10-18: also excludes Docker/bridge/Gluetun addresses in IPv4 and IPv6-mapped form (osquery query no longer selects pid and skips UDP >= 32768).
query: (event.action:modified and labels.snapshot_item:"cmd:listen") or (osquery.name:listening_ports and osquery.action:added and osquery.counter > 0 and not osquery.columns.address:("0.0.0.0" or "::" or 127.* or 10.10.* or 172.* or 192.168.* or 10.2.0.* or \:\:ffff\:127.* or \:\:ffff\:10.10.* or \:\:ffff\:172.* or \:\:ffff\:192.168.*))
